data.one_liner: String validation and sanitization library for Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive set of string validation and sanitization functions, such as checking for email formats, URLs, numeric values, and cleaning or escaping string inputs. It also supports extension methods to call these functions directly on string instances.
use_when: You need to validate user inputs like emails, URLs, or specific formats.
You want to sanitize and clean strings before processing or storing them.
avoid_when: You are building complex multi-field form validation schemas that require form state management.
You need specific UI text field masking inputs.
strengths: Extensive collection of validators and sanitizers ported from validator.js.
Convenient extension methods for direct usage on String instances.
No external dependencies and supports all platforms.
weaknesses: Does not integrate directly into Flutter's Form/FormField validation state out of the box without manual callbacks.

alternatives.name: email_validator
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick this alternative if you specifically only need robust email address validation.

alternatives.name: formz
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick this alternative if you need robust standalone form validation models with status handling.
